floorplans.furniture.kitBy.context: Under a furniture kit’s name in the catalogue: who made the free 3D models and their licence (such as “CC0 1.0”, free for anyone to use).

params.author: Who made the kit, such as “Kenney”.

floorplans.furniture.kitSource.context: Link under a furniture kit’s name in the catalogue, to the website the free 3D models come from.

floorplans.furniture.mount.context: Where a piece of furniture is: standing (on the floor, or on the piece under it, such as a TV on its cabinet) or hung on a wall (a floating TV cabinet).

floorplans.furniture.name.context: Label of the field naming a plain box or cylinder placed on the plan, such as "Piano".

floorplans.furniture.namePlaceholder.context: Placeholder of the name field of a plain box or cylinder on the floor plan.

floorplans.furniture.nothingFound.context: Shown in the furniture catalogue when the search finds nothing.

floorplans.furniture.nothingPlaced.en: Nothing placed on this level yet. Pieces you place show up here, to add another.
floorplans.furniture.nothingPlaced.context: The furniture catalogue’s “In this plan” tab when the level has no furniture yet.

floorplans.furniture.onCeiling.context: Small tag beside a device’s shape in the catalogue that goes on the ceiling (a ceiling light, a smoke detector).

floorplans.furniture.onWall.context: Small tag beside a piece of furniture in the catalogue that hangs on a wall (a TV, a radiator, a shelf).

floorplans.furniture.outline.context: The shape of a table’s top: a rectangle, a rectangle with rounded corners, an oval (round when its width and depth are equal), or natural: a gently irregular, organic edge like a slab of a tree.

floorplans.furniture.ownKit.context: Heading of the catalogue’s section of pieces Tiledash draws itself from their size (a box, a table of any shape, your own shape), not from a downloaded 3D model.

floorplans.furniture.ownKitHint.en: Shaped to the size you give them.
floorplans.furniture.ownKitHint.context: Under “Drawn by Tiledash” in the furniture catalogue: these pieces are drawn from their size.

floorplans.furniture.pictureArt.context: Label of the colour of what is in a picture frame (the painting or poster itself), not the frame.

floorplans.furniture.pictureCustom.context: The choice of a picture size typed in the width and height fields instead of a usual one.

floorplans.furniture.pictureFrame.context: A picture’s frame: a thin frame, a thick frame, a canvas (deep, no frame, the picture wrapping round its sides), or a poster (flat, no frame).

floorplans.furniture.pictureFrameLabel.context: Label of the choice of a picture’s frame on the floor plan.

floorplans.furniture.pictureSize.en: {size, select, a4 {A4} a3 {A3} a2 {A2} other {{w} × {h} cm}}
floorplans.furniture.pictureSize.context: A picture’s usual size: paper sizes A4, A3, A2, or a size in cm such as 50 × 70 cm.

floorplans.furniture.pictureSizeLabel.context: Label of the choice of a picture’s (a painting’s or poster’s) usual size on the floor plan.

floorplans.furniture.pictureWay.context: Label of the choice whether a picture hangs upright (portrait) or on its side (landscape).

floorplans.furniture.pictureWayOption.context: A picture upright (portrait, taller than wide) or on its side (landscape, wider than tall).

floorplans.furniture.pieceTab.context: Tabs in the panel of a selected piece on the floor plan: its details (name, device, size, colour), where it is (standing or on a wall, turn, height, distances to the walls), and its shape (which piece of the catalogue it looks like).

floorplans.furniture.pieceTabs.context: Accessible name of the tabs in the panel of a selected piece of furniture or device on the floor plan.

floorplans.furniture.placedCount.en: {count, plural, one {Once on this level} other {# times on this level}}
floorplans.furniture.placedCount.context: Under a piece in the “In this plan” tab: how often it is on the level already.

floorplans.furniture.remove.context: Button that removes the selected piece of furniture from the plan.

floorplans.furniture.screenSize.context: Label of the slider setting a TV’s size by its screen’s diagonal, in inches.

floorplans.furniture.screenSizeValue.context: A TV’s screen size in inches, then the width and height that gives it, in cm.

params.inches: The diagonal in inches, such as 55.

floorplans.furniture.search.context: Placeholder and label of the search field above the furniture catalogue.

floorplans.furniture.seats.context: Label of the number of chairs standing around a table.

floorplans.furniture.show.context: Toggle in the editor’s top bar that shows or hides the furniture on the plan, for drawing walls without it in the way.

floorplans.furniture.size.context: The size of a piece of furniture under its name in the catalogue: width × depth.

floorplans.furniture.solidHint.en: Click: add a corner · Click the first corner or press Enter: done · Backspace: take back a corner · Shift: no snapping · Esc: stop
floorplans.furniture.solidHint.context: Hints along the foot of the floor plan editor while you draw your own shape (a solid block such as a boxed-in corner) corner by corner. Parts separated by " · " (keep that separator); keys are keyboard keys.

floorplans.furniture.solidSize.context: Next to your own shape while it is drawn on the floor plan: its width and depth so far.

floorplans.furniture.tableTop.context: Label of the choice of a table’s top: its shape seen from above.

floorplans.furniture.title.context: Title of the editor’s side panel with the furniture catalogue, and the name of the Furniture tool.

floorplans.furniture.turn.context: Label of how far a piece of furniture is turned, in degrees, with buttons to turn it 15° either way.

floorplans.furniture.turnLeft.context: Button that turns the selected piece of furniture 15 degrees anticlockwise.

floorplans.furniture.turnRight.context: Button that turns the selected piece of furniture 15 degrees clockwise.

floorplans.furniture.wallHint.en: Hangs on the wall. Drag it along the wall to move it.
floorplans.furniture.wallHint.context: Note in the panel of a piece of furniture hung on a wall.

floorplans.furniture.width.context: Label of a piece of furniture’s width, in cm.

floorplans.lineUp.align.context: Heading over six buttons that line the selected items up on one edge or their middles.

floorplans.lineUp.alignEdge.en: {edge, select, left {Left edges} centre {Horizontal centres} right {Right edges} top {Top edges} middle {Vertical centres} other {Bottom edges}}
floorplans.lineUp.alignEdge.context: Tooltip of a button lining the selected items up: on their left edges, centred horizontally (their middles on one vertical line), on their right edges, their top edges, centred vertically (their middles on one horizontal line), or their bottom edges.

params.edge: left, centre (centred horizontally), right, top, middle (centred vertically) or bottom.

floorplans.lineUp.cmUnit.context: The unit after a distance field: centimetres, as its symbol.

floorplans.lineUp.distances.context: Heading over four fields with a selected item’s distance to the nearest wall each way.

floorplans.lineUp.distancesHint.en: Type a distance to move it there. The arrow keys nudge it 1 cm, 10 cm with Shift.

floorplans.lineUp.noWall.context: Shown in a distance field when there is no wall that way.

floorplans.lineUp.remove.en: Delete {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}}
floorplans.lineUp.remove.context: Button that deletes all selected items from the plan.

floorplans.lineUp.several.context: Title of the side panel when several items (furniture and devices) are selected.

params.count: How many items are selected (two or more).

floorplans.lineUp.severalHint.en: Drag one to move them together. Shift-click adds or takes one.
floorplans.lineUp.severalHint.context: Line at the top of the panel for several selected items.

floorplans.lineUp.side.context: Label of one distance field: the wall to the left of the item, to the right, above it or below it on the plan.

params.side: left, right, up (above the item) or down (below it).

floorplans.lineUp.space.context: Heading over two buttons that put equal gaps between three or more selected items.

floorplans.lineUp.spaceAxis.en: {axis, select, x {Left to right} other {Top to bottom}}
floorplans.lineUp.spaceAxis.context: Tooltip of a button spacing the selected items evenly, across or up and down the plan.

params.axis: x (left to right) or y (top to bottom).

floorplans.lineUp.spaceNeedsThree.en: Select three or more to space them.
floorplans.lineUp.spaceNeedsThree.context: Shown instead of the spacing buttons when only two items are selected.

floorplans.modelPreview.asBuilt.context: After the size, when the model was given another size than it was built at: its own size.

floorplans.modelPreview.colours.context: Label: how the model is coloured.

floorplans.modelPreview.coloursValue.context: How the model is coloured: its own colours, or the colours of the chosen theme.

floorplans.modelPreview.detail.context: Label: how many triangles and how big the file is.

floorplans.modelPreview.detailValue.en: {triangles, plural, one {# triangle} other {# triangles}} · {kb} KB
floorplans.modelPreview.detailValue.context: How detailed the model is (its triangles) and its file’s size in kilobytes.

floorplans.modelPreview.fromAbove.context: Caption of the model drawn from above, as the 2D floor plan draws it.

floorplans.modelPreview.fromFront.context: Caption of the model drawn flat from its front.

floorplans.modelPreview.fromSide.context: Caption of the model drawn flat from its left side, its front on the right.

floorplans.modelPreview.front.context: Button: look at the model from the front and side again, as at first.

floorplans.modelPreview.listed.context: Label: the furniture group the model is listed under, such as "Living room".

floorplans.modelPreview.made.context: Label: how the model was made.

floorplans.modelPreview.madeValue.en: {made, select, parts {From parts, by an AI assistant} other {From a file}}
floorplans.modelPreview.madeValue.context: How the model was made: described as parts (boxes, cylinders…) or uploaded as a file.

floorplans.modelPreview.mount.en: {mount, select, wall {On a wall} ceiling {On the ceiling} other {On the floor}}
floorplans.modelPreview.mount.context: Where the model goes in a room.

floorplans.modelPreview.partShape.context: Column: the part’s shape (box, cylinder, sphere…).

floorplans.modelPreview.partShapeValue.en: {shape, select, box {Box} cylinder {Cylinder} sphere {Sphere} extrusion {Outline} loft {Loft} lathe {Turned profile} other {Shape}}
floorplans.modelPreview.partShapeValue.context: A part’s shape. Outline: a flat outline pushed out. Loft: several outlines joined into one shape, as in 3D modelling tools. Turned profile: a profile turned around an axis, like a vase on a lathe.

params.shape: box, cylinder, sphere, extrusion, loft or lathe.

floorplans.modelPreview.partSize.context: Column: the part’s size in centimetres.

floorplans.modelPreview.partTone.context: Column: what the part is made of.

floorplans.modelPreview.partToneValue.en: {tone, select, soft {Fabric} metal {Metal} glass {Glass} plant {Plant} lamp {Lamp} other {Wood}}
floorplans.modelPreview.partToneValue.context: What a part is made of; it decides its colour in a theme.

params.tone: wood, soft, metal, glass, plant or lamp.

floorplans.modelPreview.partWhere.context: Column: where the part is, in centimetres from the model’s back left corner on the floor.

floorplans.modelPreview.parts.context: Heading of the list of the parts the model is made of.

floorplans.modelPreview.sits.context: Label: where the model goes in a room.

floorplans.modelPreview.size.context: Label: the model’s width, depth and height.

floorplans.modelPreview.sizeValue.context: The model’s width × depth × height in centimetres.

floorplans.modelPreview.turnLeft.context: Button: walk a quarter around the model to the left, to see another side of it.

floorplans.modelPreview.turnRight.context: Button: walk a quarter around the model to the right, to see another side of it.

floorplans.modelPreview.view3d.en: The model in 3D. Drag to look around it.
floorplans.modelPreview.view3d.context: Read out for the 3D view of the model.

floorplans.modelProducts.anyRoom.context: Choice of the Suggested room field: the model is not meant for one room in particular.

floorplans.modelProducts.arrange.context: Label of the switch in the furniture catalogue and the community’s models page: list pieces by type or by room.

floorplans.modelProducts.arrangeChoice.context: Choices of the Show by switch.

floorplans.modelProducts.brand.context: Label of the field for the maker of a model’s real product (Sonos, IKEA).

floorplans.modelProducts.brandCount.context: A brand to pick under the Brand field, with how many community models have it.

floorplans.modelProducts.brandPlaceholde.context: Example in the empty Brand field: a well-known brand that needs no translation.

floorplans.modelProducts.brandSuggestion.context: Label of the row of brands others already used, under the Brand field, to pick one with the same spelling.

floorplans.modelProducts.looks.context: Label of the field describing how a model or piece looks: materials, colours, shapes. Used to draw pictures of the plan.

floorplans.modelProducts.looksCount.context: Characters used in the How it looks field, out of the most allowed.

floorplans.modelProducts.looksNote.en: Materials, colours and shapes, as you see it from above and from the side. No logos or text.
floorplans.modelProducts.looksNote.context: Line under the How it looks field.

floorplans.modelProducts.looksPlaceholde.en: Matte black fabric wrapped all round, a gloss black top with a shallow touch strip, rounded ends.
floorplans.modelProducts.looksPlaceholde.context: Example in the empty How it looks field of a model: a soundbar described.

floorplans.modelProducts.pending.context: A type or room the person proposed that an admin hasn’t reviewed yet, as a choice in the list.

floorplans.modelProducts.pieceLooks.context: Label of the field in a placed piece’s panel to describe how that piece really looks (a green velvet sofa), for pictures of the plan.

floorplans.modelProducts.pieceLooksModel.en: Adds to how the model says it looks.
floorplans.modelProducts.pieceLooksModel.context: Line under the How it looks field of a placed model, which has a description of its own.

floorplans.modelProducts.pieceLooksNote.en: Pictures of this plan draw it this way.
floorplans.modelProducts.pieceLooksNote.context: Line under the How it looks field of a placed piece.

floorplans.modelProducts.pieceLooksPlace.en: Green velvet, buttoned back, dark wooden feet
floorplans.modelProducts.pieceLooksPlace.context: Example in the empty How it looks field of a placed sofa.

floorplans.modelProducts.product.context: Heading of the part of the model dialog for the real thing a model stands for: its brand, product name and how it looks.

floorplans.modelProducts.productLine.context: A model’s real product as one line under its name: the brand then the product (Sonos Arc Ultra).

floorplans.modelProducts.productName.context: Label of the field for the product’s own name (Arc Ultra, Söderhamn).

floorplans.modelProducts.productNote.en: If it is a real product, say which. Others find it by brand, and pictures of your plan draw it as it really looks.
floorplans.modelProducts.productNote.context: Line under the Real product heading.

floorplans.modelProducts.productPlacehol.context: Example in the empty Product field: a product name that needs no translation.

floorplans.modelProducts.propose.context: Last choice in the Type and Suggested room lists: opens a field to suggest a type or room that isn’t listed.

floorplans.modelProducts.proposeIt.context: Button that sends the proposed type or room for review.

floorplans.modelProducts.proposeNote.en: An admin checks new ones first. Until then you see it, and others see this model under {kind, select, type {Anything else} other {Any room}}.
floorplans.modelProducts.proposeNote.context: Note under the field to propose a new type or room.

floorplans.modelProducts.proposePlacehol.context: Example shown in the empty field to propose a new type or room.

floorplans.modelProducts.proposeRoom.context: Label of the field to propose a new room (for example "Laundry room").

floorplans.modelProducts.proposeType.context: Label of the field to propose a new item type (for example "Robot mowers").

floorplans.modelProducts.proposedLimit.en: You have {count} waiting for review. Propose more once an admin has looked at them.
floorplans.modelProducts.proposedLimit.context: Shown instead of the propose field when the person has the most proposals waiting.

floorplans.modelProducts.roomLabel.context: Label of the optional field for the room a model is meant for. A soundbar has none; a bath has Bathroom.

floorplans.modelProducts.type.en: {type, select, seating {Sofas and armchairs} tables {Tables} chairs {Chairs and stools} beds {Beds} storage {Cabinets and shelves} kitchen-units {Kitchen units} appliances {Appliances} climate {Heating and cooling} baths-showers {Baths and showers} toilets-basins {Toilets and basins} audio-video {Audio and video} lighting {Lighting} decor {Plants and decor} vehicles {Vehicles} other {Anything else}}
floorplans.modelProducts.type.context: Name of an item type: what a piece of furniture or a model is, whichever room it stands in. Used as a heading in the furniture catalogue and as a filter on the community’s models page. "Anything else" holds pieces that fit no type.

params.type: seating, tables, chairs, beds, storage, kitchen-units, appliances, climate, baths-showers, toilets-basins, audio-video, lighting, decor, vehicles or other.

floorplans.modelProducts.typeLabel.context: Label of the field for what a model is (Sofas and armchairs, Audio and video…).

floorplans.modelProducts.what.context: Label of the field for a plain word for the thing (a soundbar, a three-seat sofa).

floorplans.modelProducts.whatPlaceholder.context: Example in the empty What it is field: a plain, lower-case noun.

floorplans.modelSuggestions.fitsDevice.context: After a product in that list: which of your devices is one, such as "Sonos Arc Ultra · your Living room Arc".

floorplans.modelSuggestions.fitsHeading.context: Heading in the dialog of one of your own 3D models: the products of the devices it was placed on, so others with the same product are offered it.

floorplans.modelSuggestions.fitsNone.en: None yet: show one of your devices as this model on a floor plan.
floorplans.modelSuggestions.fitsNone.context: Shown when the model fits no product yet.

floorplans.modelSuggestions.fitsNote.en: Learned when you show one of your devices as this model. Others with the same product are offered it once it is on the community.

floorplans.modelSuggestions.fitsRemove.context: Label of the button that takes a product off the list, for a wrong one. Read by screen readers.

floorplans.modelSuggestions.forMyDevices.context: Filter on the community’s models page: only models of the products and brands of your own Homey devices.

floorplans.modelSuggestions.from.context: Where a model in the list comes from: one of your own, one you installed from the community, or one on the community you haven’t installed.

floorplans.modelSuggestions.heading.context: Heading above the list of 3D models that fit a placed device, in its Shape tab. {device} is the device’s name in Homey, such as "Living room Arc".

params.device: The device’s name, such as "Living room Arc".

floorplans.modelSuggestions.inUse.context: Shown instead of the Use button on the model the piece already is.

floorplans.modelSuggestions.installUse.context: Button on a community model you haven’t installed: installs it and shows the placed device as it.

floorplans.modelSuggestions.installs.context: How many people installed a community model, after its publisher’s handle.

floorplans.modelSuggestions.make.en: Make one with your AI assistant
floorplans.modelSuggestions.make.context: Link after "No models … yet": opens the guide to building a 3D model with an AI assistant such as Claude, through Tiledash’s MCP server.

floorplans.modelSuggestions.match.en: {match, select, exact {Fits this device} product {This product} other {Same brand}}
floorplans.modelSuggestions.match.context: Small label on a model in the list: "Fits this device", someone used this model on a device of the very same product; "This product", the model is of the same product by name; "Same brand", only the brand is the same.

floorplans.modelSuggestions.none.context: Shown in the Shape tab when the device names its product but no model of it exists. {product} is the brand and product, such as "HomeWizard P1 Meter".

params.product: The product, such as "HomeWizard P1 Meter".

floorplans.modelSuggestions.noneAny.en: No models of this product yet.
floorplans.modelSuggestions.noneAny.context: The same, for a device that names no product by name.

floorplans.modelSuggestions.notNow.context: Button that hides the card for this piece. Nothing on the plan changes.

floorplans.modelSuggestions.nudgeAll.en: {count, plural, one {See the model} other {See all # models}}
floorplans.modelSuggestions.nudgeAll.context: Button on that card: opens the Shape tab with every model that fits the device. {count} is how many.

params.count: How many models fit the device.

floorplans.modelSuggestions.nudgeTitle.context: Title of a small card under a placed device on the floor plan, when a 3D model of the very product it is exists. {product} is the product, such as "Sonos Arc Ultra".

params.product: The product’s brand and name, such as "Sonos Arc Ultra".

floorplans.modelSuggestions.nudgeTitleAn.en: Show it as the real thing?
floorplans.modelSuggestions.nudgeTitleAn.context: Title of the same card when the device names no product, only which product it is by an id.

floorplans.modelSuggestions.otherOfBrand.context: Subheading for models of the same brand as the device but not the same product, such as "Other Sonos models".

floorplans.modelSuggestions.pageFits.en: {count, plural, =0 {Fits your {device}} other {Fits your {device} and # more}}
floorplans.modelSuggestions.pageFits.context: On a community model’s page: which of your Homey devices are the product this model is. {device} is the first one’s name.

params.count: How many of your devices it fits, less the one named.
params.device: The first device’s name, such as "Living room Arc".

floorplans.modelSuggestions.use.context: Button: shows the placed device as this model on the plan.

floorplans.models.add.context: Button in the furniture catalogue of the floor plan editor: add your own 3D model.

floorplans.models.addIt.context: The dialog’s main button: keeps the fitted model and puts it in the catalogue.

floorplans.models.addTitle.context: Title of the dialog that adds your own 3D model to the floor plan’s catalogue.

floorplans.models.back.context: Button: the previous step of the dialog.

floorplans.models.checking.context: Shown while the server reads, checks and compresses the uploaded model file.

floorplans.models.community.context: Heading of the furniture catalogue’s group of 3D models installed from the Community (what other people shared).

floorplans.models.communityLoading.context: Screen reader text while the furniture catalogue loads the Community’s models. Grey placeholder tiles show meanwhile. Not visible as text.

floorplans.models.communityOffline.en: Couldn’t reach the Community. Models you installed are still here.
floorplans.models.communityOffline.context: Text in the furniture catalogue when the Community’s models could not be loaded. A button "Try again" follows it.

floorplans.models.deleteText.en: {count, plural, =0 {It isn’t on any floor plan.} one {It’s on # floor plan, which shows a plain piece in its place.} other {It’s on # floor plans, which show a plain piece in its place.}}
floorplans.models.deleteText.context: Text of the dialog that asks before deleting one of your own 3D models: what happens to the plans it is on.

params.count: On how many floor plans the model is placed.

floorplans.models.deleteTiles.en: {count, plural, one {# tile shows it and will say the model is gone.} other {# tiles show it and will say the model is gone.}}
floorplans.models.deleteTiles.context: After the text of the dialog that asks before deleting one of your own 3D models: how many dashboard tiles (Model widgets) show it, and that they will then say it is gone. Only shown when there are some.

floorplans.models.deleteTitle.context: Title of the dialog that asks before deleting one of your own 3D models.

params.name: The model’s name, such as "Our sofa".

floorplans.models.deleted.context: Toast after deleting one of your own 3D models.

floorplans.models.drop.en: Drop a 3D model here, or choose a file
floorplans.models.drop.context: The large drop area in the Add a model dialog.

floorplans.models.fitHint.en: Stand it upright with its front toward you: the arrow on the floor points out of its front.
floorplans.models.fitHint.context: Line above the turning buttons in the Add a model dialog.

floorplans.models.fitTitle.context: Step of the Add a model dialog where the person turns the model upright and gives its real size.

floorplans.models.formats.en: GLB or glTF, OBJ, or USDZ from an iPhone scan, up to {mb} MB.
floorplans.models.formats.context: Line under the drop area: the file types that work, and the largest file.

params.mb: The largest file in megabytes, such as 25.

floorplans.models.inGroup.context: Small text on the picked Community model in the furniture catalogue: the catalogue group it lands in once installed.

params.group: The catalogue group, such as "Living room". Already translated.

floorplans.models.install.context: Button on a model’s Community page: install it, so it is in the floor plan’s furniture catalogue.

floorplans.models.installFailed.en: Couldn’t install {name}. It shows as a plain piece until it is.
floorplans.models.installFailed.context: Red message (toast) when a 3D model from the Community, just placed on the floor plan, could not be installed. The plan shows a plain box in its place meanwhile.

params.name: The model’s name, such as "Egg chair". Not translated.

floorplans.models.installed.context: Line after installing a model from the Community: where it is in the furniture catalogue.

params.group: The catalogue group, such as "Living room". Already translated.

floorplans.models.installedFromCommunity.context: Green message (toast) after a 3D model from the Community was installed by placing it on the floor plan. A button "View" follows it.

params.name: The model’s name, such as "Egg chair". Not translated.

floorplans.models.keepShape.context: Switch: changing one of the width, depth and height changes the others with it.

floorplans.models.leadLook.en: The colours it’s drawn in, and how it looks from above on the 2D plan.
floorplans.models.leadLook.context: Line at the top of the Look tab.

floorplans.models.leadModel.en: What it’s called and what it is, so you find it in the catalogue.
floorplans.models.leadModel.context: Line at the top of the Model tab.

floorplans.models.leadSize.en: Its real size, so it fits your plan, and whether it stands, hangs on a wall or from the ceiling.
floorplans.models.leadSize.context: Line at the top of the Size tab.

floorplans.models.look.context: Label of how the model is coloured.

floorplans.models.lookTextures.context: Choice: the model keeps its own colours and pictures (textures), as a scan has them.

floorplans.models.lookTheme.context: Choice: the model takes the theme’s tones, like the built-in furniture.

floorplans.models.mine.context: Heading of the furniture catalogue’s group of the person’s own 3D models.

floorplans.models.moreCommunity.context: Heading of the furniture catalogue’s group of 3D models other people shared on the Community that the person has not installed yet, the most used first. Placing one on the plan installs it.

floorplans.models.name.context: Label of the model’s name, such as "Our sofa".

floorplans.models.notInstalled.en: Not installed: placing it installs it
floorplans.models.notInstalled.context: Screen reader label of the small download mark on a Community model in the furniture catalogue that is not installed yet. Not visible as text.

floorplans.models.placingInstalls.en: Not installed yet: placing one on the plan installs it for you.
floorplans.models.placingInstalls.context: Small text under the heading "More from the Community" in the furniture catalogue of the floor plan editor.

floorplans.models.problem.en: {problem, select, unreadable {This file couldn’t be read as a 3D model.} toolarge {Even compressed, it’s {value}: at most {limit}. Export it with fewer details, or smaller textures.} triangles {It’s too detailed: {value} triangles, at most {limit}. Most scanning apps can export a lighter version.} complex {It’s too much to read: it needs more memory or time than a model may use. Export it with fewer parts, or smaller textures.} busy {Your models are still being worked on. Try again in {value} seconds.} other {This model can’t be used.}}
floorplans.models.problem.context: Why an uploaded model can’t be used, and what to do about it. "busy": other models of yours (or everyone’s) are being worked on right now, so this one wasn’t taken; nothing is wrong with the file.

params.problem: unreadable, toolarge, triangles, complex (too much to read) or busy (try again later).
params.value: What the model has, formatted; for busy, the seconds to wait.

floorplans.models.progressMb.context: Beside the upload step of adding a 3D model: how much of the file has been sent.

floorplans.models.progressSize.context: Beside the step "Compress it": the compressed size and the most it may be.

floorplans.models.progressSlow.en: A detailed scan can take a minute. You can close this: it’s added to your models when it’s ready.
floorplans.models.progressSlow.context: Under the list of what adding a 3D model is doing, while the server works on it. The work goes on without the window; the model then shows under "Mine" in the furniture panel.

floorplans.models.progressStep.en: {step, select, convert {Make it a GLB} upload {Upload it} queued {Wait its turn} read {Read the model} topView {Draw it from above} textures {Shrink its textures} compress {Compress it} turn {Stand it as you fitted it} keep {Keep it} other {Check it}}
floorplans.models.progressStep.context: A step in the list of what adding a 3D model is doing; a mark beside it says waiting, working, done or failed. "Wait its turn": models are worked on one after another on the server, and this one waits for the ones before it. "Draw it from above" makes the picture the 2D floor plan shows. Short imperative phrases, the same form for every step.

params.step: convert, upload, queued (waits for other models before it), read, topView, textures, compress, turn (turned and tipped as fitted) or keep.

floorplans.models.progressTextures.context: Beside the step "Shrink its textures": how many pictures the model has on it.

floorplans.models.progressTriangles.context: Beside the step "Read the model": how detailed the model is.

params.count: How many triangles, already formatted, such as 282,111.

floorplans.models.retry.context: Button after "Couldn’t reach the Community" in the furniture catalogue: loads it again. A command.

floorplans.models.saving.context: Above the list of what saving a fitted 3D model is doing.

params.name: The model’s name, such as "Our sofa".

floorplans.models.scanTip.en: Scan a real piece with your phone (Polycam, Scaniverse, an iPhone’s Object Capture) or use a free model, and say its licence when you share it.
floorplans.models.scanTip.context: Tip under the drop area: where a model can come from.

floorplans.models.showMore.context: Button at the end of the group "More from the Community" in the furniture catalogue: loads more models. A command.

floorplans.models.size.context: Label of its width, depth and height in centimetres.

floorplans.models.size3.context: A model’s size: width × depth × height in centimetres.

floorplans.models.tabLook.context: Tab of the Add a model dialog: its colours and how it is drawn on the 2D plan.

floorplans.models.tabModel.context: Tab of the Add a model dialog: its name, what kind of thing it is and the room it suits.

floorplans.models.tabProduct.context: Tab of the Add a model dialog: the real product it is (brand, product) and the devices it fits.

floorplans.models.tabSize.context: Tab of the Add a model dialog: its real size and where it sits (floor, wall, ceiling).

floorplans.models.tip.context: Label of the two buttons that tip the model a quarter forward or back, to stand up one that lies down.

floorplans.models.tipBack.context: Button: tip the model a quarter back.

floorplans.models.tipForward.context: Button: tip the model a quarter forward.

floorplans.models.topView.context: Label of how the model is drawn on the plan seen from above.

floorplans.models.topViewMade.en: Drawn from the model, seen from above.
floorplans.models.topViewMade.context: Line beside the made top view of the model.

floorplans.models.topViewPicture.en: Use a picture of your own
floorplans.models.topViewPicture.context: Button: upload a picture to show on the 2D plan instead of the made top view.

floorplans.models.topViewRemove.context: Button: drop the uploaded 2D picture and draw the model from above again.

floorplans.models.tryAnother.context: Button after a problem with an uploaded model.

floorplans.models.turn.context: Label of the two buttons that turn the model a quarter left or right.

floorplans.models.turnLeft.context: Button: turn the model a quarter to the left.

floorplans.models.turnRight.context: Button: turn the model a quarter to the right.

floorplans.models.usedBy.en: {publisher} · {count, plural, =0 {new} one {# uses it} other {# use it}}
floorplans.models.usedBy.context: Small text on a Community model in the furniture catalogue: who shared it and how many people installed it, such as "@kees · 41 use it".

params.count: How many people installed it. A number.
params.publisher: The publisher’s Community name, such as "@kees". Not translated.

floorplans.models.viewInCommunity.context: Button in the message "… installed from the Community": opens the model’s page on the Community. A command.

floorplans.picture.angle.context: Label over the choice of angle a 2.5D picture is seen from, as the Floor plan widget’s Angle setting.

floorplans.picture.angleName.context: One angle a 2.5D picture is seen from: isometric (35°), game-style (30°, flatter) or steep (50°, more from above). As the Floor plan widget names them.

floorplans.picture.another.context: Button after a picture is made: goes back to the style step for another try.

floorplans.picture.bothHint.en: The night one, and the same picture by day with the lamps off. Tiles follow your theme or the sun.
floorplans.picture.bothHint.context: Under the day and night choice: what the two pictures show and when tiles use which.

floorplans.picture.chosen.context: Heading over the picture of this level that Floor plan tiles show now.

floorplans.picture.day.context: Switch over a picture: shows its daytime version.

floorplans.picture.dayAndNight.context: Option: a night picture and a daytime one of the same view, costing two credits.

floorplans.picture.dayHint.en: Daylight through the windows, the lamps and the TV off.
floorplans.picture.dayHint.context: Under the day only choice: what the picture shows.

floorplans.picture.dayOnly.context: Option: one picture, by day with the lamps off, costing one credit.

floorplans.picture.deleteFailed.context: Notice when deleting a picture of a level failed.

floorplans.picture.doneTitle.context: Heading when the picture is made.

floorplans.picture.example.en: An example, in the style you picked
floorplans.picture.example.context: Caption over example pictures in the versions step.

floorplans.picture.failed.en: {why, select, refused {The image model refused this one. Your credits are back.} other {This one didn’t work out. Your credits are back.}}
floorplans.picture.failed.context: Shown on a try that failed; the credits it cost were given back.

params.why: refused (the image model’s safety check) or failed.

floorplans.picture.generate.en: {count, plural, one {Make it · # credit} other {Make it · # credits}}
floorplans.picture.generate.context: Button that starts making the picture, with what it costs.

floorplans.picture.gets.context: Heading of the list of what is sent to make the picture.

floorplans.picture.getsDrawing.en: Tiledash’s drawing of the level, seen {view, select, 2d {from above} other {at an angle}}
floorplans.picture.getsDrawing.context: An item of the list of what is sent: the drawing it restyles.

floorplans.picture.getsList.en: What is where: {rooms} rooms, {pieces} pieces of furniture, {lights} lights and {openings} doors and windows, by name, colour and place
floorplans.picture.getsList.context: An item of the list of what is sent: the level described in words.

floorplans.picture.getsStyle.context: An item of the list of what is sent: the style.

floorplans.picture.hint.en: A picture of this level made from your plan, for Floor plan tiles: by night with every light on, by day, or both. The tile can switch to the live plan.
floorplans.picture.hint.context: Line at the top of the Picture panel.

floorplans.picture.hintDismiss.context: Button in the one-time note: closes it for good.

floorplans.picture.hintShow.context: Button in the one-time note: opens the Picture panel.

floorplans.picture.hintText.en: Tiledash can turn this level into a realistic picture for your Floor plan tiles, in the same styles as your pictures in Settings › Houses. Your devices still work on it.
floorplans.picture.hintText.context: Text of the one-time note at the floor planner’s picture button: what the button does. Houses is the settings section where pictures of your house are made in several styles; point to it as "Settings › Houses", as other texts do.

floorplans.picture.hintTitle.context: Title of a small note at the floor planner’s picture button, shown once, the first time the floor planner opens after pictures came.

floorplans.picture.level.context: Label of the choice of the floor of the house to picture.

floorplans.picture.makeOpen.context: Button in the Picture panel that opens the steps to make a new picture of the level.

floorplans.picture.makeTitle.context: Heading over the choices for a new picture of the level.

floorplans.picture.making.en: Making your picture… This takes about a minute.
floorplans.picture.making.context: Shown while the picture is being made.

floorplans.picture.makingHint.en: {both, select, yes {About a minute for the night one, another for the day one} other {About a minute}}. You can close this: it shows up in the Picture panel when it’s ready.
floorplans.picture.makingHint.context: Under the heading while the picture is being made.

params.both: yes when a night and a day picture are made.

floorplans.picture.makingTitle.context: Heading while the picture is being made.

floorplans.picture.night.context: Switch over a picture: shows its night version (every light on).

floorplans.picture.nightHint.en: Every light on, the TV on, dark outside the windows.
floorplans.picture.nightHint.context: Under the night only choice: what the picture shows.

floorplans.picture.notStarted.en: {error, select, busy {A picture is being made already.} limit {That’s enough pictures for today; try again tomorrow.} off {Making pictures isn’t available here.} render {Tiledash couldn’t draw this level. Try again.} other {The picture couldn’t be started.}}
floorplans.picture.notStarted.context: Why making a picture of a level couldn’t start, shown as a short notice.

params.error: busy, limit, off, render or failed.

floorplans.picture.oneRoom.context: Option: the picture shows one room up close, the rest faded.

floorplans.picture.open.context: Tooltip of the floor planner’s top-bar button that opens the Picture panel (not the traced backdrop picture, which has its own button).

floorplans.picture.outOfDate.en: You changed this level since this picture was made. Tiles keep showing it until you make a new one.
floorplans.picture.outOfDate.context: Note over a picture when the level’s walls, doors, windows or furniture changed after the picture was made.

floorplans.picture.readyTitle.context: Heading of the last step, before making the picture.

floorplans.picture.remove.context: Button (icon) on an earlier try: deletes it.

floorplans.picture.renderCaption.en: This is what the image model gets: Tiledash’s own drawing of this level, which it restyles. Walls, doors and furniture stay where they are.
floorplans.picture.renderCaption.context: Caption under a picture of the level as Tiledash draws it, in the first step.

floorplans.picture.room.context: Label of the choice of the room to show.

floorplans.picture.roomHint.en: The picture is made of this room up close. Floor plan tiles showing this room show it first.

floorplans.picture.sendsPlan.en: Your level’s layout, furniture and a picture of it drawn by Tiledash go to OpenAI to make it.
floorplans.picture.sendsPlan.context: Fine print under the Make button: what is sent to the image service.

floorplans.picture.show.context: Label of the choice between a picture of the whole level or of one room.

floorplans.picture.showSummary.en: {room, select, none {The whole level} other {{room}{fade, select, yes {, the rest faded {level}%} other {}}}}
floorplans.picture.showSummary.context: In the summary of the last step: what the picture shows.

params.room: The room’s name, or none for the whole level.

floorplans.picture.single.context: Option: one picture, at night with every light on, costing one credit.

floorplans.picture.step.en: {step, select, view {Level and view} style {Style} versions {Versions} other {Make it}}
floorplans.picture.step.context: The steps at the top of the dialog, each a button that goes to it.

floorplans.picture.title.context: Title of the editor’s side panel where a picture of the level is made, and the button that opens it.

floorplans.picture.tries.context: Heading over the pictures made of this level before.

floorplans.picture.tryLabel.context: Under an earlier try: its style, its view and when it was made.

floorplans.picture.turn.context: Label over how far the house is turned in a 2.5D picture: 0°, 90°, 180° or 270°.

floorplans.picture.use.context: Button on an earlier try: makes it the picture Floor plan tiles show.

floorplans.picture.versions.context: Label of the choice between one picture or a day and a night one.

floorplans.picture.versionsHint.en: With both, a tile shows the night one on dark themes or after sunset, as you choose.

floorplans.picture.versionsTitle.en: By night, by day, or both?

floorplans.picture.view.context: Label of the choice between a picture seen from straight above (2D) or at an angle.

floorplans.picture.view25d.context: Option: the picture seen from above at an angle, like a doll’s house.

floorplans.picture.view2d.context: Option: the picture seen from straight above, like a plan.

floorplans.picture.viewHint.en: Turn it the way you know your house; for 2.5D, pick the angle your tiles use too.

floorplans.picture.wholeLevel.context: Option: the picture shows every room of the level.

floorplans.picture.wizardTitle.en: A picture of your floor plan
floorplans.picture.wizardTitle.context: Title of the dialog with the steps that make a picture of a level.

floorplans.quickTips.actions.context: Floor planner first-use quick tips: actions.

floorplans.quickTips.actionsHelp.en: Choose what tapping, holding and double-tapping a linked device does.

floorplans.roomDevices.climate.context: Label above a list of the room’s thermostats and heating devices where one is chosen for the room.

floorplans.roomDevices.climateHint.en: Its temperature and target show on the room’s label.
floorplans.roomDevices.climateHint.context: Help text under the Climate list: the chosen device’s temperature and target temperature are shown with the room’s name on the plan.

floorplans.roomDevices.covers.context: Label above a list of the room’s blinds, curtains and shutters, each with a checkbox: the ticked ones open and close together.

floorplans.roomDevices.coversCount.en: {count, number} of {total, number} opened and closed together
floorplans.roomDevices.coversCount.context: Small text beside the Covers label: how many of the room’s blinds and curtains are ticked to open and close together.

params.total: How many covers the list offers.

floorplans.roomDevices.flow.context: Small hint under a flow’s name in the Moods and flows list. A Homey term.

floorplans.roomDevices.intro.en: Devices for the whole room, not a spot in it. A tap on the room opens its card with them.
floorplans.roomDevices.intro.context: Help text under the Room devices heading. “Its card” is a small panel with the room’s controls that opens on a Floor plan tile.

floorplans.roomDevices.lights.context: Label above a list of the room’s lights, each with a checkbox: the ticked ones are switched together from the room’s card.

floorplans.roomDevices.lightsCount.context: Small text beside the Lights label: how many of the room’s lights are ticked to be switched together.

params.total: How many lights the list offers.

floorplans.roomDevices.media.context: Label above a list of the room’s media players (speakers, a TV) where one is chosen as the room’s player.

floorplans.roomDevices.mood.context: Small hint under a mood’s name in the Moods and flows list. A Homey term.

floorplans.roomDevices.none.context: Choice in the Media player or Climate list meaning the room has no player or no climate device.

floorplans.roomDevices.nothing.en: None in this room’s zone or on the plan in it.
floorplans.roomDevices.nothing.context: Shown in place of a Media player, Climate, Lights or Covers list when the room has no such device.

floorplans.roomDevices.offPlan.context: Small hint beside a device in the lists: it is in the room’s zone on the Homey but not placed on the plan.

floorplans.roomDevices.onPlan.context: Small hint beside a device in the lists: it is placed in this room on the plan.

floorplans.roomDevices.scenesHint.en: Buttons on the room’s card, in this order.
floorplans.roomDevices.scenesHint.context: Help text under the Moods and flows heading.

floorplans.roomDevices.scenesTitle.context: Heading of a section in the room panel: the Homey moods and flows shown as buttons on the room’s card. Mood and flow are Homey terms.

floorplans.roomDevices.tab.context: Tab in the floor plan editor’s room panel, beside Room and Actions: the room’s devices, moods and flows.

floorplans.roomDevices.tickOnPlan.en: Tick the {count, number} on the plan in this room
floorplans.roomDevices.tickOnPlan.context: Link-style button above an empty Lights or Covers list: ticks all of that kind placed in this room on the plan.

floorplans.roomDevices.title.context: Heading of a section in the floor plan editor’s room panel: the devices that belong to the whole room rather than a spot in it.

floorplans.roomDevices.tourDevicesBody.en: Pick the room’s player, thermostat, lights and covers here. On a Floor plan tile, a tap on the room opens its card with them.
floorplans.roomDevices.tourDevicesBody.context: Text of that guided tour step. “Its card” is a small panel with the room’s controls; “Floor plan” is the name of a dashboard widget.

floorplans.roomDevices.tourDevicesTitle.context: Title of a short guided tour step pointing at the Devices tab of the room panel, shown once the first time someone selects a room.

floorplans.roomDevices.tourEndAction.context: Button that ends the short guided tour about room devices.

floorplans.roomDevices.tourEndBody.en: On your own dashboards the card’s ⋯ changes them too, without opening the floor planner.
floorplans.roomDevices.tourEndBody.context: Text of the card ending the guided tour. ⋯ is a small button with three dots on the room’s card; keep it as the symbol.

floorplans.roomDevices.tourEndTitle.en: Every room can have its own
floorplans.roomDevices.tourEndTitle.context: Title of the card that ends the short guided tour about room devices: each room can have its own devices, moods and flows.

floorplans.roomDevices.tourScenesBody.en: Add the moods and flows the room’s card offers, in the order you want them.
floorplans.roomDevices.tourScenesBody.context: Text of the second guided tour step.

floorplans.roomDevices.tourScenesTitle.context: Title of the second guided tour step, pointing at the Moods and flows list in the room’s Devices tab. Mood and flow are Homey terms.
